title: Aureline M5 AI review policy hook
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for an AI review policy hook. Names the object class, its review-pack association, the pack version and digest the AI run used, the pack-driven policy, whether a divergent pack version was disclosed, and the evaluator result class the AI result inherits — so AI review never runs under a different pack version without disclosure. Downstream the AI review panel, review detail, provider handoff, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating an AI policy binding by hand. Raw prompts, secret values, and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
